description: Winter and holiday projects dominate this run as Pat and Mat face deep snow, Christmas lights, a sauna, nativity building, trees and presents before extending the celebrations through New Year's Eve, festive food, black ice, an igloo and a New Year's greeting.

s13e01.description: A heavy snowfall buries the yard almost to the windows, so Pat and Mat must clear a way out and inevitably find a more ambitious use for the mountain of snow they create.

s13e02.description: Pat and Mat decorate the house with Christmas lights, but their enthusiasm for illumination pushes the electrical system beyond what festive spirit alone can safely power.

s13e03.description: One of the pair comes in frozen from the cold, inspiring Pat and Mat to build a sauna at home rather than merely warm up in any conventional fashion.

s13e04.description: A missing figure spoils the nativity scene, so Pat and Mat decide that replacing one piece is far less satisfying than constructing an entirely new display themselves.

s13e05.description: When an artificial Christmas tree is damaged, Pat and Mat look to the garden for a replacement and turn finding, cutting and preparing a real tree into another seasonal construction job.

s13e06.description: Wrapping Christmas presents proves unexpectedly awkward, and Pat and Mat respond by treating paper, ribbon and oddly shaped gifts as a packaging problem that deserves tools and engineering.

s13e07.description: With New Year's Eve prepared but midnight still inconveniently far away, Pat and Mat look for ways to accelerate the celebration rather than submit to the tyranny of the clock.

s13e08.description: Preparing potato salad means cutting and mixing a surprising amount of food, so Pat and Mat search for faster methods and soon produce quantities that raise a new question: who is going to eat all of it?

s13e09.description: A gingerbread house refuses to stay together, and Pat and Mat apply the logic of real construction to pastry, reaching for tools and structural reinforcement instead of accepting a collapsing dessert.

s13e10.description: Black ice turns the simple act of taking out the rubbish into a hazardous journey, giving Pat and Mat an excuse to combine transport, winter maintenance and recreation.

s13e11.description: Fresh snow inspires Pat and Mat to build an igloo, and what begins as a garden novelty steadily acquires the ambitions and complications of a second home.

s13e12.description: A Christmas carp needs somewhere suitable to stay before dinner, and Pat and Mat discover that maintaining the right water conditions is a surprisingly technical problem.

s13e13.description: Pat and Mat want an original New Year's greeting, so they build an elaborate photographic backdrop from household objects and turn a simple card into a full studio production.
